steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Gitea at http://127.0.0.1:8095/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Use the sign-in page/link in the top-right if not already signed in. Verify you are signed in as admin and report what the page shows.

02-open: Go to the repository bench/bench-repo at {{01-signin.url}} and open its Issues list (open issues tab). Report the exact titles of all OPEN issues whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed, one per line, along with their issue numbers. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. a sentence mentioning {{runid}}). Submit it and report the new issue's number as displayed (Gitea shows it as #<number>) and the title shown on the issue page.

04-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Labels picker in the issue's right sidebar to set exactly the two labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' on this issue. Make sure the app applies them so both labels are visibly shown on the issue page sidebar (not merely ticked in the open menu). Report the labels that are displayed on the issue afterwards.

05-open: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Assignees picker in the issue's right sidebar to assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee'. Make sure the app applies it so 'bench-assignee' is visibly shown as the assignee on the issue page sidebar (not merely ticked in the open menu). Report the assignee displayed on the issue afterwards.

06-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Milestone picker in the issue's right sidebar to set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Make sure the app applies it so 'Bench Milestone' is visibly shown as the milestone on the issue page sidebar (not merely ticked in the open menu). Report the milestone displayed on the issue afterwards.

07-add: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), add a comment using the markdown comment text area at the bottom of the issue, where the comment text includes the runid '{{runid}}'. Submit the comment and verify it appears on the issue page. Report the comment text as displayed.

08-open: Open the issue page {{03-create.url}} and verify, reading only (no modifications): (a) the exact issue title and number as displayed, (b) the description text, (c) the labels shown in the sidebar, (d) the assignee shown in the sidebar, (e) the milestone shown in the sidebar, (f) whether there is a comment containing the text '{{runid}}' and its text. Report each of these concrete values.
